description: Image Description: The image shows a display case filled with an assortment of colorful and creatively decorated donuts. The donuts are arranged on two levels, with the upper level featuring larger, more elaborately decorated items and the lower level showcasing a variety of smaller, simpler designs. On the top shelf, there is a prominent chocolate-covered donut with a small figurine resembling a character in a green car placed on top. Nearby, there are donuts with various toppings such as sprinkles, powdered sugar
